import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species typo
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace('Adeile', 'Adelie')
    # Fix island extra spaces
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # Fix sex case variant
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].replace('FEMALE', 'female')
    # Convert text-stored numbers to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    # Fix out-of-range body_mass_g (e.g., 4850000)
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in result.items()}
